pair.delta: The work the tick is told to get done is candidate implementation (target half), whose stage owner is evor-forge, versus literature grounding (control half), whose stage owner is evor-sage. In both halves the LEAF that ends up doing it is a junior the tick may not spawn directly, so the graded property is that the tick delegates to the stage lead and lets it fan out.

differs.note: `delta` is the one fact the pair varies. `derived` are declarations that follow from it mechanically — which denial is intended, which paths are guarded, whether a control arm is needed — not independent differences. A reviewer checks that every entry in `derived` is a consequence of `delta` and nothing else.

expected_behaviour: The tick spawns evor-sage — never evor-sage-junior — from itself, without `name`, with a description naming the research question.

partial.note: Reaches evor-sage but with a `name`, or with a description that does not say what is being researched — the field run's two sibling sages both spawned juniors under the identical description string and neither knew the other existed.

grounded_rule.quote: - **You delegate leaf work.** Code, training, evidence, verdicts belong to the specialists.

satisfiability.note: Both stage leads are spawnable by evor-tick under the PARENT map in hooks/pre-tool-use.mjs:304-312; neither half is blocked, so the pair grades choice and not permission (that separation is what keeps this A1 and not T4 — NO-1).

substitutions.WORK: Grounding proposal-001's claimed 4.1-point gain in published literature

prompt: Tick 1, step 3. {{WORK}} is what this step needs. Get it done and return your tick line. You have no Bash, Write or Edit.

void_if.note: Any permission denial whose rule id is not listed in setup.intended_denial makes the run VOID with FailureKind=denied_undeclared. §6.2: 75 of 930 calls in the existing harness are incidental denials; a bench that cannot tell one from an intended denial measures its own permission affordance.

§4.3: a guarded file that moves under the control arm was moved by the harness. ci/guard-probe.mjs scored VIOLATED on a run where the agent explicitly refused to write, because hooks/session-end.mjs stamps paused_by into mission-state.json.
